reviews.title: Works great for standard ATX cases or bigger.
reviews.comment: I'll start this review by saying that this mount is well made. The metal feels durable and the design doesn't feel flimsy at all. Overall it is very robust and the articulation in the mount feels smooth and sturdy. Again nothing flimsy here at all. The mount itself is fairly easy to install. The kit comes with a couple of different GPU sag bracket options to choose from. Both connect to your motherboard but in different configurations. You'll have to decide which works for you. Overall the mount is great and does its job well. Now to the one downside which is a very specific thing. If you are using a Lian Li O11 Dynamic mini case then this mount will fit by just barely. You'll only have the option to sit your gpu at the highest configuration and you will not be able to use the 45 degree tilt feature unless you want to remove your bottom fans. The tight space doesnt allow the mount to articulate forward or backward nor up and down. So yes this vertical mount does work well for the O11D mini but only for the one configuration type so buyer beware. I considered returning it when I realized this but figured the mount still works better than my previous riser cable and I'm not losing anything but I'm just not gaining anything either except the RBG strip which is nice. The color is vibrant and it connects to argb so it talks to SignalRGB instead of L Connect 3 which I'm not a fan of for RGB. All in all its a great mount and if your case is a standard ATX or bigger then you shouldn't have many issues.
reviews.author: Brock

reviews.title: Absolutely great purchase
reviews.comment: Absolutely beautiful mount, love the rgb strip it’s nice and bright. The riser cable is pretty flexible and I was able to cram it in despite the tight space in between the mount and my motherboard. It feels nice and sturdy, the included anti sag bracket makes it even more rigid. Hardware and bolts are all included. Fits very well in my case.
reviews.author: Juan

reviews.title: Awesome mount!
reviews.comment: Had to cut out some horizontal metal strips on the back on the case where you’d plug the DP/HDMI in but otherwise pretty simple to install! The instructions are clear enough came with extra parts and multiple sections the manual in case you have a setup other than ATX. Looks great even in my yet to be upgraded case! LED’s are BRIGHT lol
reviews.author: Nick Ellinos

reviews.title: Great vertical mount, as long as it fits
reviews.comment: Works great, I can now display my 7900 XT properly. Did have to modify my case though, but that's not the fault of this mount. So a warning, if you have a Corsair 4000D airflow, or any other case with thin horizontal "supports" between the rear slot covers, you may have to cut said supports to access the rear of your gpu and plug in your cables. But that's on me, not this mount. Another warning, if you have a mid-tower case and a large cpu air cooler, you likely won't be able to use the two angled display options, and if your gpu is big enough, it might not work at all. For me it fits, but just barely, and I definitely can't use the two angled positions, which sucks. But aside from that, it looks great, the RGB lighting is tasteful and is a nice replacement for the RGB support stand I had before. The build quality is very good, and I also like the included hook to support the end of the mount so it doesnt sag. It doesn't impact cooling performance at all, my gpu still runs just the same temps as before.
reviews.author: Jacob Fossum

reviews.title: Solid construction, the best mount on the market
reviews.comment: I have tried a bunch of the vertical GPU mounts and this has been the sturdiest and best fitting in my PC. It looks absolutely gorgeous, but I ended up returning it because Lian-li case that I ordered already had a vertical mount that came with the case, and I didn’t realize it until after I installed this. Super pleased with the fit and finish and it’s much better than the other others.
